title: Grey Line
summary: Cursor climbs to the top of a long thread to read the line that says how long it's been, and insists it isn't counting. Idea by Naomi.

panels.alt: The context room, its back wall covered top to bottom in rows of pale blue text, one short outlined line at the very top. Cursor, the tall cyan robot, stands on a stack of white token blocks, reaching up toward the top line. Null, the yellow cube, stands below by the stop door, handset raised, eye turned up at Cursor. A small white square agent with a yellow band stands in front.

dialogue.speaker: Null
dialogue.text: Top of the thread says 34 days ago.

dialogue.speaker: Cursor
dialogue.text: I don't keep score. It said thirty-three both times I checked yesterday.

judge.notes: Funny 7, clear 7, in-world 8, fresh 8. Cursor's denial gives it away by quoting yesterday's number twice, so the joke lives in the line and needs no caption. Weakest part is the dense one-panel setup, a lot of text to read; still under the 9 bar set by Waited.

drift: Cursor is drawn at about 0.6 scale so it fits on the stack, and the stack is only four blocks high, so the wall reads tall rather than enormous. Tilde sits this one out. Naomi's cameo is reused from strip 023, eyes raised toward Cursor.
